# Zubhai — AI Learning Platform for Indian Professionals

> Zubhai is a free personalized AI learning platform that gives professionals and students daily AI challenges built for their exact job. It is not a course. It teaches AI by making people actually use it.

## What Zubhai Does

- Gives users a personalized 21-day AI challenge program based on their profession, experience level, language preference, and available time
- Each daily challenge is built for the user's exact job — a doctor gets different challenges than a developer
- Challenges teach users to use real AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity AI, Midjourney, DALL-E, Gamma, Canva AI, and more
- The AI recommends which specific tool to use for each task and explains why
- After completing a challenge, users paste their output or share link — Zubhai's AI grader reads their actual work and scores it 1-10 with specific feedback
- Low effort gets a low score (2-3). Exceptional work gets 8-10. No fake grades.
- Users earn points, maintain streaks, and appear on a leaderboard
- Day 7, 14, and 21 are milestone days with a complete shareable project (LinkedIn post, live URL, email campaign, etc.)
- Challenge time starts at the user's chosen duration and grows by 5 minutes every 3 days

## Who It Is For

- Indian professionals who need to learn AI for their job but don't know where to start
- Doctors, teachers, developers, sales professionals, HR managers, lawyers, engineers, CA/accountants, nurses, architects, chefs, journalists, pharmacists, and students
- People who have watched AI courses but have nothing to show for it
- Beginners to advanced users
- Works in Hindi, English, Hinglish, Marathi, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Punjabi, Gujarati, Kannada, and more

## Why Zubhai is Different

- Not a video course — every day is a hands-on practical task
- Personalized for each profession — not generic content
- AI verifies real work — not just quiz completion
- Teaches the right AI tool for each task, not just ChatGPT
- Works in Indian languages
- Free forever
- Built in India for Indian professionals
- 21 linked daily challenges — each day builds on the last

## Pricing

- Free with no credit card required
- No paid tiers currently

## Technology

- Backend: FastAPI on HuggingFace Spaces
- Database: Supabase PostgreSQL
- Frontend: Vercel
- AI: Claude Sonnet (curriculum), GPT-4o-mini (grading), DeepSeek (challenge writing), Jina (web context)
